limitations: Synthetic: one stated mill per gauge class (the demo mills), not any plant; the products differ in gauge, flow stress, tension and speed only.
Inputs are literature values from the product catalogue (a survey of excerpts, patents, standards previews and vendor or trade pages); each row carries the read status.
Assumed values are labelled per row (flow stress without a published as-rolled strength, reduction without a published span, the tension fractions, friction 0.03, the mill).
Doubled (pack-rolled) final passes are not modelled: no bite, only per-sheet bite-free thresholds.

Roll bites below about 60 um come from the experimental mattress model (order of magnitude); below 20 um exit gauge or above 50 % reduction from its unvalidated extended domain. The force range used for the credibility mark is reported for battery-foil passes only.
Chatter numbers are open-gap linear screening values; above the span-wave limit they are flagged not reliable.
Nothing here is validated against plant data; rankings compare model sensitivities on a synthetic mill, not plant defect rates.
Literature survey only: every value is quoted from three research reports, not measured.
No plant validation: a value inside a published span is not evidence that a pass is good.
Vendor and trade pages are low-confidence; several standards were read from previews only.
Finished-product tensile strength is not the rolling flow stress; that comparison is an indicator only.
Spans mix minima, typical values and ranges from different sources; read the basis.

summary: 24 catalogue products, one synthetic final pass each: 19 with a roll bite, 5 doubled (bite not modelled), 1 with a bite marked not credible, 18 with an assumed flow stress. Coil ridges (critical ridge height at the outer coil radius): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +0.99). Troughs and creases in the exit span (trough onset lateral stress, magnitude): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +0.99). Roller wrinkles on the deflector roll (threshold magnitude): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +1.00). Cooling stripes visible in the mill (in-mill onset height of a roll stripe): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), brazed_fin_stock (89.4 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.47); 6 excluded. Cooling stripes visible after tension release (after-release onset height, an upper bound where reporting-limited): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), container_foil_retortable (91.7 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.43); 6 excluded. Chatter margin (survey speed over the critical speed without bite damping): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), container_foil_retortable (91.7 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.11); 10 excluded. These are model sensitivities on one synthetic mill per gauge class with literature inputs, not plant defect rates.
